issue.title: Restore Bob Obsidian Sync and establish a sub-1 GB footprint policy
issue.description: Obsidian Sync completes end to end on athena and the MacBook from a fully reconciled, backed-up vault whose charged storage is below the Standard plan's 1 GB limit, with explicit and repeatable decisions about every excluded or unsupported content class.

issue.title: Reconcile live, local, remote-only, and historical storage
issue.description: audit: produce a read-only, cross-device inventory that distinguishes live bytes, stranded remote entries, pending uploads, and charged version history.

issue.title: Preserve every copy and approve the new sync policy
issue.description: protect: capture independent snapshots, reconcile divergent device state, and obtain explicit approval for the rebuild and optional exclusions.

issue.title: Rebuild the remote vault with exclusions preconfigured
issue.description: recover: replace the history-bloated remote vault, seed it from the reconciled tree, and reconnect each device without uploading excluded content.

issue.title: Prove quota headroom, round trips, and data completeness
issue.description: verify: demonstrate green sync cycles, cross-device round trips, a sub-limit storage reading, and manifest-level preservation.

issue.title: Record the footprint policy and operational audit
issue.description: document: update the runbook with measured recommendations, the rebuild procedure, and a reproducible redacted footprint audit.

payload.entry: Verified read-only audit report and inventory in research/202608; parsed summary JSON and 7065-row inventory JSONL, git diff --check clean, no epic symbols remain; live remote is 5804 files / 109.222 MiB and billed UI usage is explicitly marked awaiting Bryan's desktop reading.

Protect-phase work complete pending user decisions. Quiesced athena: stopped ob-sync-bob.service, commented out the 30 3 * * * bob-nightly cron line (original saved to /tmp/crontab_bak_bob-cli-1l2_20260827T142313Z.txt -- MUST restore before/at start of phase recover). MacBook Obsidian was left running (could not pause a live GUI session unilaterally); flagged as a question. Took independent hash-verified rsync snapshots of the complete athena (14043 files) and MacBook (6952 files) vault trees, including .git/old_lib/lit_review/.obsidian, to /mnt/hercules/backup/bob-cli-1l2-protect/20260827T142411Z/ (separate RAID array from both source devices). Re-verified all 96 non-directory remote-live-not-in-git files from the phase-1 audit against a fresh MacBook hash manifest: 95/96 identical, 1 differs only due to a live edit during the snapshot window (today's daily note) -- durability gap closed without a risky new pull-only headless client. Built a full cross-device reconciliation: 6386 identical, 40 real content conflicts (mostly Pomodoro/task-ledger files edited on both devices during the outage -- both versions preserved, no auto-merge attempted), 10 athena-only, 526 macbook-only (incl. lit_review/'s first-ever independent backup). Full report + conflict list + durability-check JSON committed to bob-cli--research at 202608/obsidian_sync_protect_report_bob-cli-1l.2_20260827.md and sibling files. Ending this turn via /sase_questions to obtain the plan's required destructive-decision-gate answers (rebuild-now, unsupported/XMind policy, _meta/migration exclusion, canonical device filter set/lib+lit_review drift) plus two questions that emerged from doing the work safely (pausing MacBook Sync, and how to resolve the 40 conflicts). Bead intentionally left in_progress -- phase protect's Done condition requires these recorded answers before it can close.

Decision-gate answers received and recorded. Q1 rebuild-now: yes, supersedes bob-cli-1i wait. Q2 unsupported/XMind: enable, resumes syncing 20 XMind files. Q3 _meta/migration: accept new device-local exclusion (49 files/15.318 MiB), archive outside Sync. Q4 canonical filters: athena's (old_lib only) vault-wide -- lib/ and lit_review/ resume syncing everywhere; MacBook's extra local exclusions were unintentional drift, so the canonical seed for lib/ must come from MacBook's fuller copy and lit_review/ (276 MacBook-only files) syncs for the first time. Q5 pause MacBook Sync: Bryan will pause/close Obsidian on MacBook+mobile himself before recover treats these snapshots as final baseline -- recover must wait for that confirmation. Q6 the 40 conflicts: auto-pick newest by mtime (29 MacBook, 10 athena); .obsidian/workspace.json excluded as expected device-local UI-state noise Sync never uploads (39 real picks, not 40).

Finalized and committed to bob-cli--research (202608/obsidian_sync_protect_report_bob-cli-1l.2_20260827.md, new sections 6-8, plus sibling obsidian_sync_protect_conflicts_canonical_decision_bob-cli-1l.2_20260827.tsv): the full canonical-seed-tree definition combining identical files, athena-only, MacBook-only (now including lib/+lit_review/ per Q4), and the 39 resolved conflicts, plus everything phase recover needs carried forward (crontab/service restore timing, Q5 pause-confirmation gate, Q3 exclusion, Q2 unsupported enablement, Q4 filter list). Same finalized decision TSV also written to the RAID snapshot at /mnt/hercules/backup/bob-cli-1l2-protect/20260827T142411Z/manifests/conflicts_canonical_decision.tsv.

Phase protect Done condition met: three snapshots/manifests verified (unchanged from prior note), canonical seed tree fully defined, all 40 points of device divergence resolved (39) or explicitly excluded as non-applicable (1), every policy/rebuild decision recorded. epic-symbols check: none for this bead. No epic/ancestor bead touched or closed.

Verified: independent hash-verified snapshots of athena (14,043 files) and MacBook (6,952 files) vaults exist on a third filesystem (RAID, distinct from both source devices); every live-remote file absent from Git has a verified independent copy (95/96 hash-identical, 1 differs only by expected live-edit timing). All 6 decision-gate questions (rebuild-now, unsupported/XMind, _meta/migration exclusion, canonical device filters, MacBook-pause timing, 40-conflict resolution) answered by Bryan and recorded in bob-cli--research (report + new conflicts_canonical_decision.tsv, committed). Canonical seed tree fully defined: 6,386 identical + 10 athena-only + 526 macbook-only (now including lib/+lit_review/ per Q4) + 39 conflicts resolved by newest-mtime + 1 (workspace.json) explicitly excluded as non-applicable device-local UI state. epic-symbols check: none present for this bead. No ancestor/epic bead touched.

Recover paused before destructive remote replacement: athena service inactive, nightly cron still disabled, no local sync processes; headless CLI can create/setup/configure but exposes no supported remote-delete command. MacBook is reachable but desktop Obsidian is still running, and live MacBook hashes diverged after protect for at least 2026/20260827.md (current mtime 2026-08-27 11:06:05 -0400). Built a non-destructive canonical seed draft at /mnt/hercules/backup/bob-cli-1l3-recover/20260827T150057Z/canonical_seed_full/bob (14,569 files, 4.2G), but it must not be treated as final until the Q5 pause/delete gate is confirmed and the current MacBook delta is reconciled.
